title: Therapeutic Mechanisms of Sanhuang Xiexin Decoction in Severe Acute Pancreatitis-Associated Lung Injury: Modulation of the NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Hou, Ying; Wang, Hui; You, Hongju; Zou, Yuanxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过NF-kappaB通路治疗胰腺炎相关肺损伤，仅涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the therapeutic mechanisms of Sanhuang Xiexin Decoction (SHXXD) in treating severe acute pancreatitis-associated lung injury (PALI) by modulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Active components and potential targets of SHXXD were identified through the TCMSP database. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed, followed by Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis. In vivo and in vitro experiments were performed to evaluate the anti-inflammatory effects of SHXXD in CAE-induced and LPS-induced mouse models and cellular experiments. NF-kappaB pathway activation and inflammatory cytokine expression were analyzed by Western blot and Quantitative Real-Time PCR (qPCR). RESULTS: Fifty-two active components of SHXXD were identified, including quercetin, baicalin, emodin, and berberine. On the basis of molecular docking results, these components were found to bind strongly with key inflammatory proteins, such as TNF, IL6, IL1B, and MMP9. In vivo experiments showed significant reductions in serum amylase and lipase levels and inhibited NF-kappaB pathway activation and inflammatory cytokine expression. CONCLUSIONS: SHXXD exerts therapeutic effects in treating severe acute pancreatitis-associated lung injury by modulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, making it a potential alternative treatment for PALI. Its active components, including quercetin and baicalin, reduce inflammation.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨三黄泻心汤（SHXXD）通过调节NF-kappaB信号通路治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤（PALI）的治疗机制。材料与方法：通过TCMSP数据库鉴定SHXXD的活性成分和潜在靶点。构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，随后进行基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析。进行体内和体外实验，以评估SHXXD在CAE诱导和LPS诱导的小鼠模型及细胞实验中的抗炎作用。通过Western blot和定量实时PCR（qPCR）分析NF-kappaB通路激活和炎症细胞因子表达。结果：鉴定出SHXXD的52种活性成分，包括槲皮素、黄芩苷、大黄素和小檗碱。基于分子对接结果，这些成分与关键炎症蛋白（如TNF、IL6、IL1B和MMP9）强烈结合。体内实验显示血清淀粉酶和脂肪酶水平显著降低，并抑制NF-kappaB通路激活和炎症细胞因子表达。结论：SHXXD通过调节NF-kappaB信号通路在治疗重症急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤中发挥治疗作用，使其成为PALI的潜在替代治疗方法。其活性成分，包括槲皮素和黄芩苷，可减少炎症。
